basics.description: **Azure Monitor Lab** — full portal deployment. Every setting is provided here in the UI; no local config file is required. Pick a **Resource group** and **Region**, then step through the tabs to tune workloads, monitoring, optional stages, and advanced options. Sensible defaults are pre-filled everywhere.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Main lab region; the config example uses northeurope. The Health Model preview and AI stage use swedencentral. App Service defaults to francecentral on Workloads, and Observability Agent defaults to uksouth on Optional stages; both can be changed separately.

options.text: Before deploying, prepare NetworkWatcher_<region> in NetworkWatcherRG for this subscription and selected Region using the README's Cloud Shell prerequisite step. Automatic Network Watcher enablement is not guaranteed. After deployment, run the Cloud Shell completion wrapper from the same release.

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Name prefix
basics.toolTip: Short prefix used to build resource names. Lowercase, 3-8 chars.

basics.name: alertEmail
basics.label: Alert email
basics.toolTip: Email address that receives Action Group notifications.

basics.name: vmAdminUsername
basics.label: VM admin username
basics.toolTip: Admin username for the demo VMs.

constraints.validationMessage: Lowercase, start with a letter, 3-32 chars.

toolTip.password: Admin password for the demo VMs. Must meet Azure complexity rules.

elements.name: deployLinuxVm
elements.label: Deploy Linux VM
elements.toolTip: Deploy the Ubuntu 22.04 demo VM (VM Insights).

elements.name: enableVmOtelMetrics
elements.label: Add OpenTelemetry VM metrics
elements.toolTip: Enabled by default alongside classic VM Insights for standalone Linux and Windows VMs in the existing Azure Monitor workspace. Does not apply to VM Scale Sets or support private link. Turning off on redeployment does not remove existing associations.

elements.name: deployWindowsVm
elements.label: Deploy Windows VM
elements.toolTip: Deploy the Windows Server 2022 demo VM (VM Insights).

elements.name: vmSize
elements.label: VM size
elements.toolTip: Confidential-compute size for the demo VMs. Check regional eligibility and quota; these sizes are not burstable.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a compatible confidential VM SKU, e.g. Standard_EC2as_v5.

elements.name: aksNodeVmSize
elements.label: AKS node VM size
elements.toolTip: AKS system-node size. Use a supported non-B-series SKU with at least 4 vCPUs and 4 GiB RAM; check regional eligibility and quota.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an AKS-supported system-node SKU, e.g. Standard_EC4as_v5.

elements.name: vmssSize
elements.label: Predictive autoscale VMSS size
elements.toolTip: Confidential-compute size for the predictive-autoscale scale set. Check regional eligibility and quota.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a compatible confidential VM SKU, e.g. Standard_EC2as_v5.

elements.name: appServiceLocation
elements.label: App Service dependency region
elements.toolTip: Region for App Service and its co-located diagnostic Storage and Event Hub dependencies.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an Azure region code, e.g. westeurope.

elements.name: aksNodeCount
elements.label: AKS node count
elements.toolTip: Number of nodes in the AKS node pool.

elements.name: dailyCapGb
elements.label: Daily ingestion cap (GB)
elements.toolTip: Daily ingestion cap on each Log Analytics workspace: central and Application Insights.

elements.name: enableSentinel
elements.label: Enable Microsoft Sentinel
elements.toolTip: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on the central workspace.

elements.name: enablePlatformLogsDcr
elements.label: Enable platform-logs DCR (preview)
elements.toolTip: Scenario 51 (public preview). Collects Azure Managed Grafana platform logs in the central workspace and requires a supported region.

elements.name: enableMetricsExportDcr
elements.label: Enable metrics-export DCR
elements.toolTip: Scenario 52 (GA). The DCR and central workspace must be in the same region.

elements.name: enableLawReplication
elements.label: Enable LAW cross-region replication
elements.toolTip: Doubles ingestion cost. Requires a paired secondary region below.

elements.name: lawReplicationLocation
elements.label: LAW replication region
elements.toolTip: Secondary region (must be a paired region of the primary). Required when replication is enabled.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a region short name, e.g. westeurope.

options.text: The secondary region must be in the supported list for Log Analytics workspace replication.

Core stages A-E deploy together. Configure their individual features on Workloads and Monitoring & cost. Enable any optional stages below; all are off by default and can add charges. After deployment, run the README's Cloud Shell completion step and review any remaining manual actions.

elements.name: enableAi
elements.label: Enable AI stage (Microsoft Foundry)
elements.toolTip: Deploys Microsoft Foundry, four billable model deployments, AI monitoring, alerts, and an AI FinOps workbook in swedencentral. Off by default.

options.text: The AI stage deploys billable Microsoft Foundry models in swedencentral. The portal creates the infrastructure; Cloud Shell completion prepares the agents. Follow the README's separate optional AI traffic step to generate telemetry.

elements.name: enableFabric
elements.label: Enable Fabric stage (Real-Time Intelligence)
elements.toolTip: Deploys an F2 Fabric capacity pinned to swedencentral. Indicative PAYG retail cost while active: about $0.36/hour, $8.64/day, or $262.80/month. Actual pricing varies; OneLake storage and other meters can add cost. Off by default.

elements.name: fabricAdminEmail
elements.label: Fabric administrator UPN
elements.toolTip: Microsoft Entra user UPN in the selected subscription tenant. Replace the fictitious example admin@example.com with your tenant's user UPN. Do not use an external notification alias.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a Microsoft Entra user UPN from the deployment tenant.

options.text: Cost warning: Fabric F2 is pinned to swedencentral and bills while active at an indicative PAYG retail cost of about $0.36/hour, $8.64/day, or $262.80/month. Actual pricing varies and additional Fabric usage may add charges. The deployment creates only the ARM capacity. The README's Cloud Shell completion wrapper detects it and runs Fabric SaaS setup. Review its manual-action results and suspend the capacity when the demo is idle.

elements.name: enableSreAgent
elements.label: Enable SRE Agent stage (incident investigation)
elements.toolTip: Deploys the preview Azure SRE Agent and connectors in swedencentral. Active usage is billable and always-on billing can begin after an eligible trial. Requires subscription-level role-assignment permission.

options.text: Azure SRE Agent uses a preview API, is pinned to swedencentral, and creates a subscription-scope Monitoring Contributor assignment for its connector identity. Cloud Shell completion validates the agent and prints its portal URL. Delete the agent before the trial ends if you do not intend to continue with paid usage. Custom investigators and response plans are configured after deployment.

elements.name: enableObservabilityAgent
elements.label: Enable Observability Agent stage (autonomous operations)
elements.toolTip: Deploys the preview Azure Copilot Observability Agent, a dedicated Azure Monitor workspace, autonomous alert correlation, and least-privilege RBAC. Chat and deep investigations consume Azure Agent Credits.

elements.name: observabilityAgentLocation
elements.label: Observability Agent region
elements.toolTip: The agent and its Azure Monitor workspace must share a supported region.

elements.name: enableObservabilityAgentAutomaticInvestigation
elements.label: Automatically investigate agent-created issues
elements.toolTip: Billable deep investigations run automatically for every issue the agent creates. Leave off for cost-controlled demos.

options.text: Azure Copilot Observability Agent autonomous operations are in preview. The deployment creates a dedicated Azure Monitor workspace, grants Issue Contributor there and Monitoring Reader directly on this lab's Application Insights resource, and monitors that resource. Cloud Shell completion validates the deployed agent. Alert correlation is automatic; deep investigation remains manual unless explicitly enabled.

elements.name: grafanaAdminObjectId
elements.label: Grafana administrator object ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave empty to grant your deployment identity Grafana Admin. For automation or a different lab operator, enter the Microsoft Entra user or group object ID, not an application client ID.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a nonzero Microsoft Entra user or group object ID in GUID format, or leave empty.

elements.name: ownerTag
elements.label: Owner tag
elements.toolTip: Value for the 'owner' tag applied to every resource.

elements.name: appServiceRepoUrl
elements.label: App Service sample repo URL
elements.toolTip: Public GitHub repo deployed to the App Service.

elements.name: siemWebhookUrl
elements.label: SIEM / Teams webhook URL (optional)
elements.toolTip: Optional secondary SIEM/Teams webhook added to the Action Group. Leave empty to skip.

elements.name: enableSlotFailureScenario
elements.label: Enable broken deployment-slot recovery scenario
elements.toolTip: Automatically uses the Standard S2 plan with one worker, provisions a dedicated customer app and broken slot, and allows an approved Control Center action to swap only that customer app.

options.text: This option automatically uses Standard S2 with one worker and increases App Service cost. The broken slot is isolated to the dedicated customer app; the Control Center stays available. Recovery must be performed externally with Azure SRE Agent in Review mode or the documented GitHub Copilot CLI workflow.

elements.name: enableCustomerDependencies
elements.label: Enable real customer SQL, orders queue and processor
elements.toolTip: Requires the dedicated customer app/workload stage. Creates billable SQL Basic (2GB), Service Bus Standard (orders queue 1GB), Flex Consumption worker (40 maximum instances), identity storage and private SQL networking. Explicit operator SQL bootstrap and worker ZIP publication are required afterward.

elements.name: sqlEntraAdminObjectId
elements.label: SQL Microsoft Entra administrator group object ID
elements.toolTip: Object ID of the Microsoft Entra group selected as SQL administrator. The administrator type is automatically Group. This is not a subscription ID, tenant ID or application client ID. Required only when both customer scenario options are enabled.

constraints.validationMessage: Supply the administrator group's nonzero Entra object ID, not a client ID.

elements.name: sqlEntraAdminName
elements.label: SQL Microsoft Entra administrator group name
elements.toolTip: Name of the selected SQL administrator group. Complete post-deployment setup as a member of this group.

options.text: Customer SQL uses Microsoft Entra authentication only and automatically selects a Group administrator: provide the administrator group's object ID and name above, not a SQL password. Azure subscription ownership does not automatically grant SQL database administration. Run Cloud Shell completion as a member of this group. These details are not needed when customer SQL dependencies are disabled.
